title: Contract
description: The frontmatter of contracts/<context-slug>/<contract-slug>.md. A domain event is «named in the past tense» (SPEC-003 §Contract) and carries what happened; a command requests what may still be refused; an api publishes operations; a capability is the system's promise to its users and lives only in the reserved `system` namespace. Direction is required on event, command and api; consumed requires upstream. The context map is a projection of these declarations: a context pair with no contract between them has gone separate ways. An api's `answers` say what each operation answers, accepted and refused; the condition a refusal answers stays a Rule's. The body carries `## Description`.

direction.description: Whether the owning context exposes this contract or depends on someone else's. A capability is always published and declares no direction.

payload.description: The Domain Model element that gives this contract its shape.

refusal.description: Command only: the value object a refusal surfaces.

upstream.description: The published contract this consumed one depends on.

operations.description: Api only: what it exposes, by name.

answers.description: Api only: what each operation answers across the boundary — the answer it gives when it accepts, and the answer each of its refusals takes. «An answer is what a caller of the boundary reads, so it is the Contract's, published or consumed» (SPEC-003 §Contract): a status, an error value, a body's absence, in the surface's own words. The condition a refusal answers is not an answer and is not stated here a second time: it is a Rule's where one states it, named by identity in `rule`, and it is stated in `when`, one sentence, only where no Rule states it and the surface alone refuses — an identity nothing is held at, a request the operation cannot carry out. An operation appears once, and only if `operations` declares it.

refusals.when: No case is held at the requested identity.

accepted.description: What the operation answers when it accepts.

rule.description: The Rule whose condition this refusal answers, by full identity.

when.description: The condition, one sentence, where no Rule states it and the surface alone refuses.

answer.description: What the operation answers when it refuses on that condition.
